known_tradeoffs: Pijul change-set containment is a provenance relation, not proof that M is the intended merge; extra candidate changes are bounded, not interpreted.
Bounds are part of the cache key, so a verified result under different bounds is not reused.
The Lattice plan carries the quartet only through operation_identity; its single-revision source context stays unset.
The fixture producer proves orchestration only; checker soundness and receipt typing wait for Octet #1, Noble #30 and Valence #1.
